segments.title: Cold Open & Stream Setup
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the Thursday stream, manages chat and subscription alerts, banishes Peter Gibbon to the walls, and prepares for the broadcast.

segments.title: Disney Invests $1.5B in Epic Games for Persistent Universe
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins to cover Disney's equity stake in Epic Games to build a Fortnite-connected metaverse; discussion veers into Fortnite lore, IP consolidation, and layoffs at both companies.

segments.title: Study Links Nose Size to Penile Length via Cadaver Measurement
segments.notes: Chet interrupts via 'science' trigger to present a Kyoto Prefectural University study measuring stretched penile length on 126 male corpses; Case and Chet bicker about anatomy, dry spells, and corpse ethics.

segments.title: Orgasmic Birth, Arm Transplants, and Penis Transplants
segments.notes: Case reads about 'ecstatic birth' theory (0.3% incidence), then falls down a rabbit hole of vascularized composite allotransplantation — double arm transplant for Marine Brendan Marrocco and the first U.S. penis transplant (Thomas Manning, 2016).

segments.title: Debate: Has Science Gone Too Far?
segments.notes: Munch argues science has always gone too far (fire, Romans, Terminator); Crum defends progress. Munch wins poll 70/30; scoreboard updated, jacket wager discussed, bickering escalates to sexual innuendo and timeout threats.

segments.title: Rooftop Close: The Rock Slaps Cody Rhodes & Pepito Wishes on Stars
segments.notes: DJ Newsic covers WWE angle (Rock/Cody/Roman), Pepito ascends roof to wish on stars for chat, lasers malfunction, stream ends with raid callouts and Case's sign-off rap.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Manages sub alerts and graphics, wishes on stars from the roof at close, demands chat wishes.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivers Disney/Epic Games story, spars with Case over beard thickness and news coma theory, claims pure fact conduit status.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Interrupts via 'science' trigger to present cadaver nose/penis study, mocks Case's anatomy and dry spell, boasts 'realest friend' status.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues science has gone too far since fire/Romans, wins poll 70/30, updates scoreboard, wagers crew jackets on century mark.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends scientific progress, loses poll, threatens comeback, engages in escalating sexual innuendo with Munch.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical host. Hosts rooftop close, covers WWE Rock/Cody angle, manages lasers, facilitates Pepito's star wishes.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Banished to walls by Case after brief appearance; smell containment discussed.

lore_notes.fact: Mentions possibly streaming with a guest tomorrow and moving in on 'Kassim's territory' [13:51].
Trigger word 'science' summons Chet Guy the Science Eyes desk immediately [33:00].
Wins 'Has science gone too far?' poll 70/30; scoreboard updated, Munch nearing exit from teens [1:26:51].
Performs 'wish upon a star' segment from roof with DJ Newsic, collects chat wishes [1:41:58].

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a truncated Thursday broadcast covering Disney's $1.5B Epic Games investment, a cadaver study linking nose size to penile length, and a deep dive into vascularized composite allotransplantation including arm and penis transplants. Munch and Crum debate whether science has gone too far, with Munch winning a 70/30 poll. The show closes on the roof with DJ Newsic covering WWE and Pepito wishing on stars for chat.
